title: Claude, the Big-Picture Helper
goal: Claude reads lots and plans careful steps.
mascot_lines: Claude is the careful kind of helper — it likes clear rules and step-by-step plans.
If you give Claude a tricky problem, it'll think it through a piece at a time.
Claude can write code, plan a story, or explain why it picked an answer.
Try it below — ask Claude to plan something with you!

tier2.rephrase: Claude is the planner. Ask Claude for a 3-step plan.

tier3.nudge: Use the words 'plan a story' or 'three steps' in your prompt.
